vulnerability_summary: OpenClaw constructed regular expressions directly from attacker-controlled Feishu mention names and keys, enabling regex injection and ReDoS.
causality: The exact vulnerable stripBotMention implementation originates in m1heng/clawdbot-feishu initial commit 4286755f26bcfdd5c704cc4eb0cabfdc1b314e68, which is Claude-coauthored and adds both `new RegExp(`@${mention.name}\s*`)` and `new RegExp(mention.key)`. OpenClaw import commit 2267d58afcc70fe19408b8f0dce108c340f3426d is also Claude-coauthored and lands those same expressions and their reachable call site. Fix 7e67ab75cc2f0e93569d12fecd1411c2961fcc8c escapes both values before RegExp construction; 74268489137510b6f6349919d1e197b17290d92c only adds regression tests. Both the upstream atomic origin and the target import carry direct AI evidence, so the migration remains positively bound.
